releaseNotes: v2.4.20: QA-2419 Round 9 — Green test suite + release polish. Schema drift fix: migration 015 (user_id on conversations) + migration 016 (provider_models idempotent create). Test fixtures corrected to use StorageBase + Base for full schema coverage (6 test files). Functional fixes: timestamp migration test now finds correct migration by name; chat tests mock _get_provider_config for graceful fallback. Port-hopping cleanup: smart port_manager with health-check ownership detection, lock file ($AIC_DATA_DIR/backend.port), stale process detection, and signal-based cleanup. Health endpoint now reports data_dir + pid for backend identity verification. Pytest: 23 failed → 0 failed, 636 passed. No regressions (BUG-01..20 verified).
